scope: Portable simulation of qualified production RTL against behavioral AXI RAM; not MIG or physical DDR latency

memory_model.mechanism: cocotbext-axi _read first word / _write final contiguous word callbacks; Timer followed by ReadOnly preserves post-edge response queuing; 10 ns core clock

timing_semantics.job: accepted START edge to final successful AXI B edge; host initialization/configuration excluded
timing_semantics.phases: disjoint pre-edge controller phases over accepted < edge <= final B
timing_semantics.burst_intervals: disjoint per burst; local terminal after final B excluded from job attribution
timing_semantics.stalls: contained diagnostics; do not add to elapsed intervals
timing_semantics.single_beat_read: remaining_r_span is zero; first response edge ends ar_to_first_r
timing_semantics.sampling: 4 ns low-phase sample checked against original Harness AXI logs; registered acceptance observed after that edge

initialization: Direct behavioral RAM initialization with the public 64-byte guarded layout; mathematical A/B/BT packing and oracle are independent of RTL
trace_scope: Job summaries and per-burst CSV contain event endpoints, counts and gap histograms; full ordered edge lists remain in the local profile.json
